## Description

2G is a compact sampler instrument from Scrap Brain Audio that turns either generated audio or your own short files into playable keyboard sounds. Its early-2000s-phone design is not just visual: the optional small-speaker mode makes a deliberately narrow, 16 kHz mono character part of the instrument.

Neural Synthesis starts from a text description, then places the resulting audio in the sampler for editing and playback. ## Key Features [...] Initial Audio SourceLab 2

## Key Features

 Neural Synthesis turns a text description into audio that can be edited and played in the sampler.
 Import WAV, AIFF, FLAC, or MP3 files up to 20 MB and 10 seconds long.
 Trim samples and shape playback with attack, release, brightness, detune, noise, quality, and formant controls.
 Loop analysis compares timbre, volume, and vibrato to suggest up to three smoother sustain-loop candidates.
 Root-note analysis detects a consistent pitch, corrects fine tuning on playback, and marks unpitched material when appropriate.
 The optional small-speaker simulation models mobile-device resonances and voice-coil compression, with a bypassable 16 kHz mono mode.
 The local sampler supports unlimited personal samples independently of Neural Synthesis credits.

A tiny neural sampler.

## Neural Synthesis

Describe the sound in your head, let 2G generate it.

## Loop analysis

Compares timbre, volume, and vibrato when determining loop points. Searches for regions that minimize abrupt shifts and short repetitions, smoothing transitions with crossfade.

Presents up to three suitable candidates when found. Select one and sustain the sample by holding the key.

2G root note analysis LCD screen

## Root note analysis [...] What is Neural Synthesis? + 

The section that generates audio from your text descriptions using AI. The generated audio can then be edited and played as a sample inside 2G.

   Can I use it without generating sounds? + 

Yes. You can import, edit, and play your own audio files. These operations consume zero credits and do not require a Studio subscription.

   Which file formats can I import? + 

WAV, AIFF, FLAC, and MP3. Up to 20 MB in file size and 10 seconds in duration. Your original source file remains untouched.

   Is an internet connection required? + 

Required only for Neural Synthesis and credit verification. Local samples can be played and edited completely offline.

   What happens if I run out of credits? + [...] Four voices share the same physical model; playing chords pushes the speaker collectively. 16 kHz mono defines 2G’s distinct handheld character, bypassable with a single switch.
